text: 1-1 INT. KATHERINE’S OFFICE – DAY
KATHERINE (caption: KATHERINE LEXON, heiress of the LEXON family) is buried in work, head down. A line of handsome men bursts into her office, bowing in unison.
Your heiress!
Emily (caption: EMILY, Katherine’s assistant) awkwardly squeezes her way through the crowd.
Ma'am! These are the twelve noble werewolf heirs the LEXON family has selected for you. You must choose one to marry.
Katherine doesn’t pause her work, only lifting her eyes to sharply scan the men— Emily pleads earnestly.

Time is running out! If you don’t get married, your inner wolf won’t awaken, and you won’t be able to claim the remaining ten percent of the LEXON family’s territory. Without that ten percent, you won’t have the leverage to overpower your stepmother
Katherine slams her pen down on the desk, standing with commanding presence as she strides toward the office door.
Let’s go!
Where to?!
Katherine walks past the men without a glance, randomly pointing at one.
Him!
Let’s go sign the papers at the registry. The man is stunned by his luck. Katherine marches out decisively. Emily excitedly waves for the man to follow as they exit.
1-2 INT. KATHERINE’S CAR – DAY
Katherine sits in the backseat, sunglasses on, silent. Emily drives up front, her expression darkening as she notices something wrong with the car behind them.
Ma'am! Something's wrong! Your chosen mate has been switched!
Katherine lowers her sunglasses, spotting the switched vehicle in the rearview mirror. She adjusts them and sits back, arms crossed.
Lose them.
There's a traitor among them! Alpha… are we still going through with the marriage?
We’re doing it. Get me a different marriage office. Katherine’s luxury car speeds down the road, swerving left and right, shaking off the pursuers.
1-3 EXT. MARRIAGE REGISTRY ENTRANCE – DAY

Katherine’s car screeches to a halt in front of the registry. The door swings open as she steps out. A strikingly handsome young man passes by. Their eyes meet. Katherine detects no werewolf scent from him.
Gorgeous… too bad he’s human.
They walk past each other. After a few steps, Katherine pauses, then turns around at the same time as him.
What’s your name? Are you single? If you are, I’m taking you as my mate!
ARTHUR (caption: ARTHUR FROSTNIGHT, leader of the FROSTNIGHT family) smirks, intrigued.
Mate? Are you asking me to marry you?
Actually— —I’m not asking you to marry me. I’m marrying you.
Serious?
Serious. Marry me, and you’ll get ten percent of the LEXON family’s land, your pick of mansions and luxury cars, and fifty million dollars annual allowance. Think about it.
The LEXON heiress?
Shame… her body’s poisoned beyond repair.
Sure!
CUT TO:

Katherine exits the registry, glancing at the marriage certificate in her hand before tossing one copy to ARTHUR. Without another look at him, she strides straight to her car. Arthur grins at the certificate—until he realizes Katherine’s car is already driving off without him.
Wait!
Then he notices something wrong with the vehicle.
Something's wrong with the car — damn!
He sprints after it in alarm.
1-4 INT. KATHERINE’S CAR – DAY
Katherine sits in the backseat when the car suddenly jolts, alarms blaring. Emily frantically checks the car.
Ma'am! The car’s damaged! That’s impossible—this thing’s bulletproof!

Katherine turns to see Arthur chasing the car through the window— Arthur grabs the door handle mid-sprint and yanks. The car lurches to a forced stop. Katherine grips the seat, stunned, as— —Arthur rips the door clean off its hinges, hoists it onto his shoulder, and glares at her.
You think you can just run off after marrying me?
2-1 INT. KATHERINE'S CAR - DAY
Arthur reattaches the car door, hops in, and slams it shut.
Drive!
Katherine stares at him, stunned.
You just ripped my car door off - and put it back on?! Do you even know how much this car costs?!
How much?
This is a custom Rolls-Royce - bulletproof, explosion-resistant, one of a kind in the world. Meaning every single screw and that door you just mangled has no replacement. This car is totaled!
Arthur blinks.
Oh... Well, too bad! I'm broke!
Katherine studies him seriously.

Then tell me — how did you manage to rip open a moving car door? That's not strength a human should have. Unless... You're also...? She leans in to sniff him, their faces close in - until Arthur suddenly pushes her back against the seat, feigning a kiss before pulling away.
That's... a secret!
Katherine huffs, flustered, straightening up.
Drive!
Yes, ma'am!
2-2 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM - DAY
Katherine leads Arthur inside. He follows, eyes wide as he takes in the lavish surroundings.
Whoa — this is your house? What are you, a Lexon royal? The pack’s lost princess or something?
More. Future Alpha.
As Arthur passes a table, he spots a hidden listening device and discreetly pockets it.
A bug?! He sidles up to Katherine.
Killer view from the top floor.
You like it? It's yours now. From now on, this is your den.
Arthur frowns, locking eyes with her.
You're not staying with me?
Katherine avoids his gaze.
I’ve got other things to take care of.
Arthur waves the marriage certificate.
Hey, we’re legally married. Aren’t we supposed to live together?
Katherine's eyes sharpen as she steps into his space.
Let me remind you one last time. I’m the one who married you, and you’re the one who married INTO my family.
Arthur raises his hands in surrender.
Alright. You’re marrying me — I’ll take the Lexon name. But know this — wherever you go, I go.
Until the Council officially announces our marriage, I’ll be staying at the Lexon estate — with my father and my stepmother. Are you sure you want to walk into that chaos?
Arthur forces a laugh, quickly waving it off.
On second thought... I'll pass!
Katherine turns to leave. Arthur's expression darkens as he prowls the apartment, uncovering hidden surveillance. Soon, he's holding a pile of devices.
Over a hundred bugs and sixty hidden cameras - just in the living room.
He mutters under his breath.
Just how many enemies does this woman have?
3-1 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM - DAY
Arthur twirls a bug between his fingers before chucking it into a duffel bag full of surveillance gear.
Track these back to their source. Pronto. FLASH vaults through the window, nearly tripping over the bag of devices.
Holy shit, Alpha! This many? Who's gunning for your mate?
Arthur levels him with a look.
Did you handle what I asked?

Look, boss...you ditch your Alpha pheromones for one trip out, and now you're signing over forty-one territories, a hundred-eight islands, and half our offshore accounts? What's this woman got on you?
Arthur flashes the marriage cert like a winning poker hand.
My wife! From now on, call me
Arthur Lexon!
Le... Lexon?! You’re the Alpha King of all packs, and you just married yourself off? into a such small family? Like... taking her name and joining her pack?
She gave me a lot! She handed over a tenth of the Lexon family’s land to me!.
Moon's blood, you've lost it...
Arthur boots him back out the window.
Go count the islands again if you're so worried!
3-2 INT. LEXON MANSION, HALLWAY - NIGHT
Katherine's strides echo as Emily jogs to keep up.
Ma’am! Just as you suspected, it was your stepmother who orchestrated the switch. She’s trying to claim that land through your husband.
Katherine doesn't break stride.
Sure. Do not let anyone know about the marriage yet. Let’s find out who’s the traitor At the double doors, Katherine kicks them open with a designer shoe—
3-3 INT. LEXON MANSION - NIGHT
—Revealing JOANNA (Subtitle: JOANNA LEXON, Katherine’s stepmother) draped over COLE (Subtitle: COLE LEXON, Katherine’s biological father) like cheap perfume.
Katherine! You’re back?
Katherine ignores him and turns to leave.
Katherine! Why are you still so rude?
Ms. Hardy, do you need something?
“Ms. Hardy”? I’m your father’s lawful wife. You should show some respect and call me Mother!
A mistress rising to power — is that something to be proud of?
You... you didn’t marry within the agreed time. Hand over the ten percent of land immediately!
Joanna grabs Cole’s arm to signal.

That’s right, Katherine. We’ve picked so many wolf heirs for you, and you rejected every single one. You still can’t awaken your inner wolf — you can’t protect the Lexon estate. It’s time to return your land to the family.
I hand over the land, and you use it to please your little mistress, right? Joanna, exasperated and weeping, clutches Cole’s sleeve.
Cole snaps, slapping Katherine.
You brat! I’m your father! How dare you speak to me like that?!
Katherine clenches her fist, glaring fiercely at Cole. Cole, frightened, turns and leaves.

By tradition, if you’re not married before the succession ceremony, you must return ten percent of your land. Without that ten percent, I become the largest landholder — I’m the true head of the Lexon family.
How are you so sure I’m not married?
You didn’t marry any wolf heir. Who else could awaken your inner wolf?
The result is the same.
Then we’ll see each other at the Council.
4-1 INT. KATHERINE’S BEDROOM — DAY
KATHERINE sits cross-legged in the center of a circle of lit candles. Her expression is serious and solemn.
Under the full moon, in the name of the First Howl, let the beast inside awake.

Katherine closes her eyes tightly, focusing deeply, feeling for any change from within—but nothing happens. After a moment, she opens her eyes and looks down at her hands, disappointment clear on her face.
I’m already married… so why can’t I awaken my inner wolf? Could it be because he’s just a normal human?
Her phone suddenly rings. She pulls it out and answers.
Hello?
Get back quick, something’s wrong!
What is it? Just say it.
Ah! It’s urgent, I’ll explain face- to-face!
Before Katherine can say more, the call disconnects. She ponders for a moment, then rises and heads out.
4-2 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, DINING ROOM — DAY
Katherine enters her apartment and walks into the dining room, where Arthur is bustling about.
The husband I married sure is pleasing to the eyes. Arthur places dishes on the table, then turns happily to see Katherine.
You’re back! Come, have a seat.
Katherine approaches; Arthur pulls out a chair for her. She sits.
I thought something huge happened, but you just wanted me to eat.
Arthur continues bringing out the rest of the dishes.
Eating is the most important thing!
He sets a bowl of blood-red soup in front of her.
Try some.
Katherine takes a spoonful and sips.
Good?
Katherine nods.
Delicious.
From now on, no more dinning out. It’s not safe.
Katherine looks uneasy.
You don’t have to do this. I didn’t marry you to have you cook for me.
What? You think I’m your pampered little husband?
Katherine hesitates.
If you’re overwhelmed, just tell me.
She pulls out her phone, ready to transfer money.
And if you’re short on money, I’ll send you more.
Arthur presses down gently on her hand, holding it warmly, looking at her seriously.
Seems like you really like sending me money. Katherine’s heart races, her face flushes. She regains composure.
Because other than money, I have nothing.
Funny—I’ve got everything except money.
Katherine freezes, their eyes lock, an odd feeling rising. She pulls back her hand.
Let’s eat!
Arthur watches contentedly as she eats heartily.
CUT TO:
Katherine puts down her knife and fork.
I’m done. Heading back to the office.
She stands and heads for the door; Arthur follows.
Remember! Don’t eat random food outside.
Katherine looks puzzled, glancing back.
Huh?
Arthur pushes her gently toward the door.
Just remember it! Aren’t you running late? Leave!
4-3 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, ENTRANCE — DAY

Arthur pushes Katherine’s shoulder; suddenly, he kisses her forehead. Then he closes the door behind her. Katherine’s heart races again, her cheeks flush. Her palm glows faintly, the stirrings of her inner wolf.
So... awakening the inner wolf needs intimate contact?!
She looks back at the door with a sly smile, determined.
That’s easy! I’ll find time to sleep with you!
5-1 INT. KATHERINE’S OFFICE — DAY
Emily walks into the office.
Ma’am, someone’s here to see you.
Katherine keeps her head down, working.
Tell them to wait.
But it’s your husband.
Katherine looks up.
Let him come in.
Emily nods and turns to welcome Arthur inside. Arthur walks in holding a takeout box. Katherine leans back in her chair.
What are you doing here?

Arthur puts the takeout on the desk, glances around, then walks away. Katherine and Emily look at him confused. Arthur walks around the office and quickly finds a bunch of bugs and pinhole cameras hidden. He breathes a sigh of relief. Katherine frowns.
Didn’t we already check? How did so many get missed…? My mistake...
They’re in really sneaky spots. You can head out now.
Emily nods and leaves. Katherine looks at Arthur.
You…
Arthur smiles and opens the takeout box.
I brought you lunch!
For someone so skilled, he’s just here to bring me food?
Arthur lays out the dishes in front of her one by one. Katherine glances at him, picks up the utensils, but notices a blood-red sauce.
What’s this?
Ketchup!
You think I’m dumb? I’m a werewolf. That smell? Ketchup?
Alright! It’s blood fern! Katherine’s eyes widen in shock, and the fork drops from her hand.
You… you treat rare herbs like food?
Every dish here has blood fern. It’s the antidote I prepared for you.
Why would I need an antidote?
Because there’s something wrong with you.
There’s something wrong with you!
I’m serious.
Arthur kneels beside her, takes her hand, and kisses the back of it. Katherine is curious and pleased, but suddenly feels a stabbing pain in her heart. Her legs gradually go numb and lose feeling.
What’s happening? I feel like I’m breaking apart...
Arthur looks at her gently.
Don’t worry, you’ll be fine in ten minutes. Now do you believe that there’s something wrong with you?
What’s wrong?
Overwork.
Katherine looks at his mischievous expression helplessly.
Just kidding! It’s Vermora. A soul-devouring poison.
6-1 INT. KATHERINE'S OFFICE – DAY
Vermora?
Arthur stands and leans against the executive desk.
It's a highly corrosive virus, very hard to detect. It slowly devours your wolf soul. Within a few years, you'll completely lose your wolf power and become an ordinary human... Or even worse.
Katherine lowers her head, distressed.
But you've eaten the food I made for you, drunk the soup and coffee I prepared. You'll recover soon.
Katherine looks up at him, skeptical.
During this time, don't eat anything else. It may interfere with the cure.
You're really not joking?
Of course not.
Understood.
Arthur looks at her appreciatively.
You are such a great patient. I'm heading home to prepare dinner for you.
He exits. Katherine watches his back thoughtfully.
How does a human know the werewolf world so well?
She presses the intercom.
6-2 INT. KATHERINE'S OFFICE – DAY
Get in touch with the Luna of the MOONMARK family. I want to meet her.
Emily enters.
That discreet healer pack? I’ve heard their Luna has healing powers. Are you feeling unwell?
Don’t let anyone know. Come with me.
Emily nods and exits.
Is it really Vermora?
6-3 EXT. MOONMARK FAMILY YARD – DAY
Katherine walks through the courtyard. An elegant Luna, MRS. MOONMARK, in a wheelchair rests in the shade. Katherine approaches.
Mrs. MOONMARK, I need your help. I think I— Mrs. Moonmark raises a hand to stop her.
Don’t move.

She lifts her palm. A glowing energy flows from her hand and surrounds Katherine. Katherine wobbles and weakens. Emily catches her. Mrs. Moonmark withdraws her hand, her wheelchair turning slightly to face them.
It's Vermora. I sit in this chair because of it. It hides for years and then strikes. Once active, it cuts your link to your inner wolf and causes excruciating pain.
Katherine looks horrified.
Even our healer bloodline couldn’t fully cure me. After surviving the soul-pain phase, I lost both my wolf soul and my legs.
You mean... I have it too?
Yes. It’s rare but curable. The problem is the antidote’s catalyst is almost impossible to find.
Our Heiress is still young. There's no way she’ll become paralyzed or lose her inner wolf!
I’ll prescribe some medicine. It won’t cure you but can delay the poison.
Katherine nods solemnly.
Thank you, Mrs. Moonmark.
Emily supports Katherine as they leave.
6-4 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, ENTRANCE – DAY
Katherine returns home with a heavy expression.
Even Mrs. Moonmark needed healing power to detect it, but Arthur just knew it with a glance. Who is he really? Inside, a voice calls out.
Alpha!
7-1. INT. LUXURY APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - DAY
Katherine enters. Arthur notices her, quickly kicks Flash away. Flash jumps out the window. Katherine chases forward, panicked.
He jumped?! From the 33rd floor?! Arthur steps in front of her.
Babe! Why are you back? I was about to bring you dinner.
Katherine shoots him a glare and walks toward the bedroom.
We need to talk.
7-2. INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, BEDROOM - DAY
Arthur follows, confused.
You didn’t test my blood. You don’t have wolf powers. How did you know I was poisoned?
I... I could tell at a glance! Your skin tone is different from a healthy person’s.
Skin tone?
Yes.
Then can you tell how long I’ve been poisoned?
Well... I need to examine you carefully. It requires... full body contact.
Katherine throws down her bag and, without a word, begins stripping.
So... ruthless?
Katherine discards her clothes, steps toward Arthur, kicks off her heels, removes her underwear.
Done.
Arthur averts her eyes, paralyzed.
Didn’t you want to examine me? Get started.
You sure?
He hesitates. Katherine removes her hair tie and blindfolds him.
Now you can begin.
Arthur stumbles forward in the dark, trips on a heel, and lands on his knees before her, face near her pelvis. Katherine looks down at him.
I haven’t inherited the alpha title yet. No need to kneel.
Arthur springs up.
Do it.
Arthur touches her hair, traces her face, lingers at her lips. Suddenly, he cups the back of her head and kisses her. Katherine pushes him away, startled, touches her lips.
You examine with your mouth?
No, hands work fine.
Then why— Arthur silences her with a finger.
Shh. The examination begins.
His hands move from her neck to her shoulders, down to her waist. He crouches, touches her thighs, gives a slight squeeze. Katherine moans involuntarily. Arthur smiles, rises, whispers in her ear.
Don’t hold back. Your husband's here.

Katherine defiantly removes his blindfold. Their eyes lock. She smirks, pushes him down. She straddles him, tosses back her hair, runs her hands over his chest, peels open his shirt. She grips his hand, pins him to the bed, fingers interlocked. Katherine leans down and kisses him.
8-1 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, BEDROOM - DAY
Katherine kisses Arthur, intensely teasing him— —but Arthur flips her over and pins her to the bed. Katherine leans into his ear.
If it feels good, don’t hold back.
She leans in for another kiss, but Arthur pulls away. Their noses brush.
Once your body’s fully recovered, I’ll make it all up to you.
He gets up and starts putting on his clothes. Katherine lowers her eyes.
How long have I been poisoned?
Eleven years. Since you were a child.
Katherine is stunned. She sits on the couch, hugging her knees.
You said there’s a cure. How long will it take?
Arthur picks up clothes from the floor.
Hard to say. Well… massage can speed up recovery. But you’d have to be completely unclothed. Interested?
KATHERINE nods firmly.
Sure.
Arthur drapes a coat over her shoulders.
Then, for treatment convenience, you’ll move in here, starting tomorrow night.
Katherine dresses.
I just remembered—I was kidnapped as a child. I don't know if that has anything to do with it.?
Could be. After all, it's easiest to do it while you're in the middle of a mess.
Katherine brushes back her hair.
I bet it was Joanna. She saw me as a threat since childhood.
Need me to look into it?
No. I’ll take care of this myself.
She exits decisively. Arthur watches her go, a subtle smirk on his face.
Such a fierce woman—it’s hard not to fall for her.
8-2 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM - NIGHT
Katherine is busy at the computer. Arthur brews coffee, pours a cup, and brings it to her.
Here. Try this.
Katherine peers inside, puzzled.
What is this? Tastes strange.
9-1 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM - NIGHT
Moon Root. It’s good for your body.
That’s a rare herb.
She takes another careful sip, looking at him.
You said you’re broke. How’d you get it? Even healer families can’t find Moon Root.
Well... My family used to be in the Moon Root business. We don’t have much left, but enough.
Really? I feel like you’re hiding something.
Just drink it. A cup a day to detox.
Katherine nods, drinks more.
Well, thanks anyway.
Arthur takes her hand gently.
No thanks needed between married couples.
Katherine exits. Arthur watches her leave, clutching his chest. Flash jumps in through the window and rushes to him.
Alpha! Are you hurt?
I’m fine.
Flash notices the coffee on the table.
You used your own blood and Moon Root to brew this?
Go back to Shadow Pack. Bring the rest of the Moon Root. She needs it.

Alpha, if you don’t care about your own health, fine! But there's only one Moon Tree in the world, and its roots can only be harvested once a century. People would only chew a piece when clinging to life, yet you're giving it to her like instant coffee?!
She’s my wife. I don’t care.
Then... can I eat the leftover roots?
Disgusting. Get out!
9-2 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, DINING AREA - MORNING
Katherine walks out in pajamas, stretching. Arthur places breakfast on the table.
Just in time. Try this oatmeal.
She takes a bite.
Mmm... delicious! What’s the secret?
Herbal infusion. Very special ingredients.
Another one of those century-old herbs?
He hesitates. She gently stirs the bowl.
I’m a light sleeper. I overheard you two last night.
She looks at him, serious.
I’ll drink all the Moon Root coffee from now on.
He exhales quietly, smiling awkwardly. She finishes the oatmeal, clearly enjoying it. He watches her, eyes full of affection.
9-3 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, BEDROOM - NIGHT
Arthur exits the shower, drying his hair, towel around waist.
Babe...
Katherine stands, slipping off her robe.
Come.
Arthur watches her in awe.
You want to...?
Katherine nods.
For the massage. He’s momentarily disappointed.
Oh... massage.
Katherine smirks. Arthur ties a hairband as a blindfold.
Let’s begin.
Arthur turns after covering his eyes. She rips off the blindfold while Arthur still has his eyes closed.
No blindfold tonight.
10-1 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT - NIGHT
Arthur pulls Katherine closer, gritting his teeth, his breathing deep.
Babe, I'm a man. If you expect me to massage you while looking at your naked body, I...
Katherine is caught in his arms, looking up at him. She laughs unconsciously.

Then what do you want? Arthur unwraps his towel and wraps it around Katherine. He picks her up and places her gently on the bed. He opens his eyes. His hand slides under the towel, gently pressing her stomach. He looks at Katherine.
Does it hurt here? Katherine, slightly nervous and blushing, shakes her head.
No.
Arthur moves his hand upward. Katherine's heartbeat quickens. She inhales deeply. Arthur pauses above her stomach, pressing lightly.
Here?
Katherine shakes her head again
Looks like it’s better now. I need to move higher. Are you ready?
Katherine nods.

Arthur slowly moves his hand. The towel shows the subtle shift of his touch as he moves upward toward her chest. Katherine grows more nervous. Her breathing deepens. She closes her eyes. Arthur lingers around her chest. Katherine lets out a soft moan, her body trembling slightly. Arthur takes a deep breath, then lifts her up to sit on his lap. Katherine’s towel slips. She gasps, her eyes opening to find herself inches from Arthur. Arthur leans in to kiss her. Katherine pushes lightly.
Didn’t you say we’d wait until I recover? Arthur’s eyes are glazed with desire.
I’m the doctor. I make the call.
He kisses her fervently. Katherine responds passionately, pushing Arthur down beneath her. They tangle intensely.
CUT TO:

After their lovemaking, the bedroom is a mess—pillows ripped, feathers floating, the bed frame nearly collapsed. Arthur sits up, a feather falling onto his head. He looks around, slightly embarrassed.
Babe...
Katherine rises slowly, looking at her hands, blood flowing with energy.
I feel the energy coursing through me.
Arthur looks at her with concern.
You don’t have to push yourself so hard. You could rely on me.
Katherine’s gaze sharpens.
No. I’ll earn what’s mine with my own hands.
Arthur looks at her, torn between concern and admiration.
The look when you pursue your goal... I love it. He places a robe over her shoulders. Kathrine grabs his hand and looks up at him.
Arthur, will you ever betray me?
11-1 INT. LUXURY APARTMENT, LIVING ROOM - DAY
Arthur kneels on one knee, his gaze intense but voice tender.
Babe, if I ever betray you... you have my permission to take my life.
What?
I'm not joking.
Katherine processes this, then stands.
I’m going to meet with the Council. You're coming with me. Bring the wheelchair.
Wheelchair? My antidote should've fixed your legs.
But the poisoner doesn't know yet. Joanna's my prime suspect, but I need proof. They'll slip up when they see me paralyzed.
Arthur nods in sudden understanding. Katherine smirks and exits. Arthur watches her go, grinning as he throws up a thumbs-up.
That's my damn queen!
Katherine flashes a blissful smile over her shoulder.
11-2 INT. LEXON MANSION, LIVING ROOM - DAY
Chaos erupts among the gathered Lexon elders. The doors swing open. Joanna enters in opulent attire, radiating smugness. Cole rises to greet her.
Joanna. You're glowing today. All eyes turn to her.
We all know Joanna has sacrificed years for this family. She's the true heir to the Lexon legacy!
Yay, Yay! Joanna's lips curl, basking in the attention.
This council meeting was called for you alone. Joanna's smile turns predatory.
Enough. Sit.
The elders comply. Joanna scans the room.
Where's Katherine? Uncomfortable silence. Averted gazes. JOANNA(CONT’D) Someone drag her down here! A true Alpha wouldn’t keeps her pack waiting? Nervous whispers. Cole clears his throat.
She's... not at the estate.
What? This is how she respects the council? She's unfit to lead!
True! Quite right!
Katherine rolls in on her wheelchair.
Then which alpha will rise to rule?
12-1 INT. LEXON MANSION, LIVING ROOM – DAY
Katherine enters in her wheelchair, pushed by Arthur. All eyes lock onto them.
So that’s why you’re late... Did your legs forget how to work?
Cole and Joanna’s loyalists barely contain their smirks.
The Lexon heir in a wheelchair? Now that’s a headline.
How’d you know it was paralysis?
Could’ve been any injury. Who’s your source?
I overestimated her. Couldn’t even wait to expose herself.
An Alpha who can’t protect her pack is no Alpha at all!
Seriously? She can’t even awaken her inner wolf, and now she’s paralyzed? There’s no way she’s fit to be Alpha!
At least my legs are the only thing not working - can't say the same for someone’ brain.
Her gaze flicks to Joanna, who slams the table.
This is the Council, not a playground for your games. You failed to marry by the deadline. That 10% territory? It goes to a vote—today.
Sign the transfer. Or we’ll enforce the rule.
Cole tosses a contract and pen onto Katherine’s lap.
As your father… I insist.
Cole grabs Katherine’s wrist to force the signature—
This is for the pack. —Arthur intercepts, crushing Cole’s hand in his grip. Bones creak. COLE(CONT’D) Ah—!
13-1 INT. LEXON MANSION, LIVING ROOM – DAY
Try it. See what happens.
Joanna glares, her composure cracking.
Katherine! Who let this outsider in here? Call off your dog—
Katherine flicks a glance at Arthur. He releases Cole with a shove. Cole stumbles back, face purple with rage—
You little brat- —Arthur casually claps his hands together, releasing a cloud of white powder.
Ugh. Filthy.
Cole wheezes, coughing violently.
What the hell?!
He’s your father, Katherine! By refusing to sign, are you daring to challenge the Pack's sacred laws?!
I wasn’t done speaking. Allow me to introduce—
She pauses, savoring the moment.
—my husband. Arthur Lexon. Owner of the 10% territory. Arthur’s eyes widen. The word "husband" hits him like a physical blow—pride and warmth flooding his chest.
The council erupt in shocked murmurs. Katherine tosses a contract onto the table.
Transfer’s signed. Any objections?
